description: A white tabletop is in front of you with a small clear plastic container open near the back, while a lump of white slime sits in the center between the hands. The left hand and right hand both press into the slime as a two-hand object, pinching and folding it inward while sliding slightly toward the center, then squeezing and reshaping it; near the end the right hand lifts and points upward while the left hand stays close to the slime.
